test.create_query: CREATE TABLE window_functions_ranking (p UInt32, k UInt32, u UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO window_functions_ranking SELECT number % 7000, (number * 7919) % 1009, number FROM numbers_mt(70000000)
